answer: Each identity registers one smart meter at one address, monitored for 30 days. One meter anchors one identity and can never register a second, like a single channel through karst. Cost is $150 plus $60 power, so one fake costs $210 and 30 days; 100 fakes cost $21,000 and 3,000 days. Cheapest cheat: rent a metered room for $300, or bribe a clerk $500 for a phantom meter; fraud fails at zero usage, clear as crystal. Each fake needs its own meter, address, and month of human-like usage, so no fake is free. Honest agents already have meters and pay nothing extra; the river of fakes dries up.
